rows.label: WELLBYs per DALY averted (Founders Pledge, 2022)

source.title: Founders Pledge, Mass media BOTECs (November 2022)
source.cell: FEM tab B30, B39, B49; DMI tab B63, B74, B84

rows.explainer: How many points of life satisfaction for a year Founders Pledge counts for one healthy year of life in its 2022 mass media analyses (FEM and DMI). It is Founders Pledge's own rate, used inside its models; our scale converts WELLBYs with the shared exchange rate afterwards. The DMI tab's note says 3.6, but its formulas use 3.7.

rows.label: Value of doubling one person's consumption for a year, in WELLBY-equivalents (Founders Pledge, 2022)

source.title: Founders Pledge, Imagine Worldwide Malawi CEA (2023), Moral weights tab, column "FP Update 2022"
source.quote: Value assigned to doubling consumption for one person for one year: 1.89765017

rows.explainer: Founders Pledge's 2022 moral weights count value in WELLBY-equivalents: 3.82 per healthy year in this tab (3.7 in its mass media sheets), 1.898 per doubled income-year and about 245 per under-5 death. These are its own value units, not life-satisfaction points measured in surveys. Dividing a Founders Pledge result by this figure puts it in doubled income-years, GiveWell's units of value, keeping Founders Pledge's own weights between deaths and income.

rows.label: GiveDirectly's cost per WELLBY (Founders Pledge, 2022)

source.title: Founders Pledge, Mass media BOTECs (November 2022)
source.cell: FEM tab B32, B42, B52; DMI tab B66, B76, B86

rows.explainer: Founders Pledge's benchmark in its 2022 mass media analyses: GiveDirectly's cash transfers buy one WELLBY for about $164. Its results are stated as multiples of GiveDirectly (164 ÷ the program's cost per WELLBY), so dividing a multiple by 164 gives back WELLBYs per dollar.
